column1: # Render cases shared by test.sh and test.ps1. Tab-separated, six columns:
#   name  cache  color  assert  expect  payload
# cache    empty      an empty but current usage cache: no per-model segment,
#                     and no refresh spawned to race the render
#          multi      two windows, "34 Sonnet only" then "61 Fable", as a Max
#          onlywin    one window, "34 Sonnet only", and nothing else
#          legacy     "Fable 61", the label-first order an older version wrote
#          stale      "61 Fable", backdated 45 minutes, with the refresh stubbed
#                     to fail so it cannot un-stale the value mid-test
#          match      output matches expect as a regular expression
#          diff       statusline.sh and statusline.ps1 must agree byte for byte;
#                     skipped when only one interpreter is present. A diff case
#                     must render the same at any instant, since the two runs
#                     are seconds apart: use an expired prompt cache rather
# expect   the string or pattern, "EMPTY" for an expected empty line, or "-"
#          for diff cases. Never blank: a harness reading tabs with `read`
#            {{R}}      workspace at a temporary Git project root
#            {{SUB}}    workspace launched in that project's logs/nested folder
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
ctx counts current input including cache
per-model picks the model in use
per-model falls back to the only window
